text:
maria: FYI spotted a cluster of Kibana hits in eu-west1 where trace_id is blank after yesterday's index rotation. A bunch of GPU provisioning errors are hard to correlate because the trace field is empty.

samir: ugh. can you paste an example doc id or a sample log line? might be pipeline strip or mapping mismatch.

maria: doc snippet: {
  index: inference-logs-2026.02.12,
  @timestamp: "2026-02-12T02:15:23Z",
  correlation_id: "c-8a3f2",
  trace_id: "",
  msg: "gpu startup failed: nvlink timeout"
}

elena: that looks like the ingest pipeline's `aggregate_trace` processor didn't run. we rotated pipeline configs during the reindex. I flagged a PR last night but assumed no live traffic would hit the old shards.

jin: checking Loki ingestion around 02:12 UTC — ingest lag spikes on eu-west1 for ~7m. Loki reports: `received but missing labels: trace_id` for ~1.1k lines. Loki-bot shows tailing errors.

oncall-bot: Alert: LokiIngestLag_eu-west1 firing (duration 00:07:12).

maria: thanks. so two failures: (1) Kibana index + ingest pipeline mismatch trimmed `trace_id`. (2) Loki didn't attach label. both break trace joins.

samir: short-term: can we backfill trace_id from correlation_id using the join index? maybe do a scripted update on affected indices. long-term: make ingest pipeline idempotent and validate presence of trace_id before indexing.

elena: I can restore the previous ingest pipeline version to stop new docs getting blank trace. rolling back now.

devops-bot: deploy started: pipeline-rollback v2026.02.11 -> rolling out to es-ingest-eu-west1 (3 nodes).

jin: while rollback runs, I'd prefer we don't run wide scripted updates without a test. proposing a targeted update: match docs where trace_id=="" and correlation_id exists, then copy from the correlation->trace join table. I'll craft an ES reindex script.

maria: patch for the Kibana saved search that looked up `trace_id` too should include `if missing then use correlation_id` fallback for now. avoids manual joins for paging.

samir: also check Prometheus alerts — we had a noisy LokiIngestLag threshold set to 1m. during control-plane maintenance that spike always fires. Can we add a maintenance window label to suppress eu-west1 noisier rotations?

elena: good call. I'll add a condition to the alert rule: `unless job=~"backup|reindex"` and add a runbook note.

maria: small command I ran to find affected shards:
```
# find docs w/ empty trace_id
POST /inference-logs-*/_search?scroll=1m
{
  "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"term": {"trace_id": ""}}, {"exists": {"field": "correlation_id"}}]}}
}
```

jin: nice. after rollback I'll run a dry-run reindex to a temp index and run trace-join queries to validate. can someone grant me write on the infra-es-* indices?

maria: grant sent. also raising a ticket: INF-4823 to track root cause, rollback, backfill plan, alert tuning, and postmortem.

oncall-bot: Ticket created: INF-4823 — "eu-west1 ingest pipeline rotation removed trace_id labels" — assigned to eng-sre.

elsena: (typo) elena: i'll own the rollback & alert tweak, jin owns the backfill, samir + maria will validate dashboard updates.

samir: timeline?

elena: rollback completed on 02:28 UTC, no new blank-trace docs after that. now running reindex dry-run.

jin: dry-run results: 980 candidate docs. will run actual backfill in 30m after snapshot. plan includes a script with `ctx._source.trace_id = lookup(ctx._source.correlation_id)` and a verification pass.

maria: leaving a note for oncall: if you see trace joins failing, check `kibana->discover` for empty `trace_id` and `loki->labels` for missing `trace_id`. run `curl` to Loki as quick check: 
```
curl -s 'https://loki.internal/api/v1/query?query={app=\"infer\",region=\"eu-west1\"}|~\"trace\"' | jq .
```

samir: thanks. postmortem should include how pipeline rotations are gated. maybe add a preflight that verifies downstream label presence (trace_id, correlation_id) before switching.

maria: agreed. marking this thread for follow-up in INF-4823. closing chat for now, will update when backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
